summary: Nexxen International Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 13, 2026, furnishing a press release of its record first quarter 2026 financial results. No corporate transaction, strategic review, or special situation is announced. The report highlights record Q1 Contribution ex-TAC ($84.5M, up 13% YoY), programmatic revenue ($81.9M, up 14%), and CTV revenue ($29.4M, up 12%). The company raised full-year guidance and plans an Investor Day on June 16, 2026. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are involved. As a routine financial results release, this filing does not constitute a special situation.
